purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry access review.
assessment: Official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue & Estate Department sources identify land-record computerization and Service Delivery Centers, and the KPLR appointment portal lists Swabi and Razar centers. The eFard/CLRMIS entry workflow searches using registered name, father’s name and CNIC after biometric verification; no identity-based lookup was attempted. No anonymous parcel-vector layer, safe geometry schema or point-to-polygon response was found. The WUP point’s relation to a specific revenue circle/mauza is unverified.
registryAssessment: The official KP Revenue & Estate Department lists Swabi among computerized land-record districts, while the official KPLR portal lists Swabi and Razar SDCs. This confirms local record-service coverage but not public geometry at the WUP point.
